name: Olympics
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Enhanced Olympics plugin with live medal counts, upcoming events, results, and countdown. Supports Vegas scroll mode and regular display mode.

versions.notes: Past the last Games in the table the countdown screen is skipped and the Vegas card omitted, instead of a permanent Display Error and an exception raised into the core. Closing day now counts as part of the Games, and medal pages are fetched only while a Games is on rather than every update all year. display() no longer runs a 15-second scrape on the render loop for its first frame; it starts a background fetch and skips the slot. Declares medal_cycle_duration and live_priority, which the code already read but the schema stripped. notifications_enabled, favorite_countries and webhooks are now deprecated and ignored: they belonged to a NotificationManager that was never instantiated, so nothing ever sent a notification, and that code is removed. The three keys are kept for compatibility and ignored: they stay declared (titled deprecated, with no default) so existing configs that carry them keep validating, since saving from the web UI does not remove them from config.json. They are still shown in the settings form until core honours x-display: hidden. Guards the VegasDisplayMode import for cores before 3.1.0, drops the unused has_vegas_content_changed, and brings the README up to date with the #410 fixes.

Remove transition.* and high_performance_transitions -- four settings in the schema and the web UI that nothing reads, and the core implements no display transitions (#381). A config.json still carrying them fails validation until it is saved again, hence the major.
Validation-sweep fixes; see the PR for the specific defect.

versions.changelog: Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid

versions.notes: Documentation. The configuration section listed 7 of the 25 settings, and four of the seven it did list were wrong: display_duration and update_interval gave defaults of 15 and 3600 where the schema says 30 and 300; logo_size does not exist in the schema at all, and because additionalProperties is false a config containing it is rejected rather than ignored; and the Transitions section documented a block no code reads. All 25 settings are now covered, with the four dead ones marked. Records two defects on the countdown screen (#410): the day count has gone negative since Milano Cortina closed, because the plugin carries one hardcoded Games and no roll-forward, and DAYS UNTIL is clipped on every panel narrower than 256, which fails six of the harness's eight sizes on main. Adds real rendered screenshots.

versions.changelog: Major update with live medals, events, results, and Vegas mode support
